description: 🆕 totalSupply for any Base token, returned raw and scaled by its decimals, alongside the name and symbol. When a contract doesn't declare decimals the answer assumes 18 and marks that it assumed — a silent guess here quietly moves every downstream number by orders of magnitude. Non-token addresses answer found:false.
